prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art UI animation sprite atlas for Sorcery: Contested Realm dark fantasy simulator.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, EXACT 1536x1280 pixels, SIX columns and FIVE rows, each cell EXACT 256x256 pixels. NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels, NO text outside icons. Each icon centered at (128,128) relative to its cell, art constrained inside 192x192 pixels. All sprites same visual scale and anchor. Crisp true pixel art as if originally drawn at 64x64 then scaled 4x nearest neighbor, hard square edges, no anti aliasing, no gradients or blur. Restrained dark fantasy palette: charcoal outlines, slate shadows, antique ivory and tarnished gold highlights, restrained spectral teal. Transparent empty space, NO background tiles. Readable silhouette at small HUD sizes. This is a time sequence, each row shows exactly SIX equally spaced frames of SAME object with small deliberate animation changes, never six different designs. First frame is resting icon, final frame settles.
Row 1 LOG: antique parchment scroll unfurled with curled ends and a few dark ink strokes (inspired by game-icons:scroll-unfurled). 6 frames: rest, slightly curl, unroll down 4px, unroll further 8px, rebound 4px, settle.
Row 2 TOOLS: a twenty-sided dice with triangular facets and clear tiny '20' on front (game-icons:dice-twenty-faces-twenty). 6 frames of tumble: front, slight clockwise tilt, quarter rotation, tilted opposite, land with small bounce, settled same face.
Row 3 SUBSURFACE OFF: rocky ground cap and cave mouth barely concealed (game-icons:cave-entrance). Six frames subtle ground settle, cave dark and closed. Small dull gold off-state indicator at lower left.
Row 4 SUBSURFACE ON: SAME rocky cave, six frames ground cap slides DOWN a few logical pixels exposing a spectral teal glowing cave mouth, remains open in final frame. Bright teal on-state indicator at lower left. Ground clearly different from OFF state.
Row 5 UNDO: ancient clock with hooked counter-clockwise arrow (game-icons:backward-time). Six frames hand sweeps counterclockwise one tick, arrow slight movement then settles. 
Repeat exact equal 256px cells and exact 6x5 layout. No shadows outside sprite silhouettes. No modern glossy app styling.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animated HUD sprite atlas for Sorcery: Contested Realm.
ONE transparent PNG EXACT 1536x1280 pixels, grid SIX columns FIVE rows, each frame EXACT 256x256. No gutters, borders, captions or labels. Icon centers exactly at each cell center. Art within 192x192px. True crisp 64x64 pixel art scaled 4x with nearest neighbor: square pixels, no antialiasing, no blur, no smooth gradients. Dark fantasy hand-crafted palette: charcoal outline, slate shadow, antique ivory, tarnished gold, restrained spectral teal, muted rust red only for cancel. Transparent empty space with no background tiles. Equal scale and consistent anchors. Each row SIX ordered animation frames of the SAME icon, small movements, clear chronological changes.
Row 1 CEMETERY: weathered gothic tombstone (game-icons:tombstone), engraved small cross and skull shape, faint teal wisp rising above stone across six frames then dissipating. Reserve bottom right logical 16x16px region for future dynamic count badge; NO baked number or badge.
Row 2 COLLECTION: leather drawstring fetch bag (game-icons:swap-bag), small antique gold swap arrows around bag. Six frames: rest, cinch, squash, puff, settle, rest. Reserve bottom right logical 16x16px empty for dynamic count badge; NO baked number or badge.
Row 3 CANCEL: strong muted rust red X (game-icons:cancel), subtle carved stone/iron look. Six frames: center, 2 logical px left, 2px right, 1px left, 1px right, center. Same X shape every frame.
Row 4 CONFIRM: antique gold check mark (game-icons:check-mark) with teal highlight. Six frames: short starting stroke, lower hooked stroke half drawn, full check drawn, full check pulses brighter slightly larger, rebound, full settled check. Same anchor.
Row 5 END TURN: hourglass (game-icons:sands-of-time) in tarnished gold frame. Six frames: sand full upper chamber, falling sand, lower chamber filling, rotate 45 degrees, rotate 135 degrees, upright settled flipped hourglass. Tiny ivory sand pixels. Hourglass remains same size throughout.
Maintain exact 6x5 equal cell grid, strong icon readability at 48px HUD scale. No ambient backgrounds, no labels, no ornamental frames, no glow blur.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animated HUD sprite atlas for Sorcery: Contested Realm dark fantasy simulator.
ONE transparent PNG EXACT 1536x1280 pixels, strict SIX columns FIVE rows, every cell EXACT 256x256 pixels, no gutter. Each icon centered in cell, keep artwork inside central 192x192 pixels. Identical icon scale, stable anchor. Crisp true 64x64 pixel art enlarged 4x nearest neighbor, hard square pixels, NO antialiasing, blur, gradient or modern glossy buttons. Charcoal outlines, slate shadows, antique ivory/tarnished gold highlights, restrained spectral teal, warning amber for armed state. Genuine transparent space, no background tiles. Every row exactly SIX animation frames of same icon, gentle chronological variation.
Row 1 CONCEDE: small ivory truce flag on antique gold pole (game-icons:truce). Six frames: folded lowered flag, begins rising, half raised, fully raised, gently flutters, settled. Same scale as other icons.
Row 2 CONCEDE ARMED 'Really?' state: SAME flag and pole but AMBER fabric, tiny dark skull emblem, and strong small amber diamond with an exclamation mark lower left. Six frames of warning pulse in pixels, steady raised flag, brighter warning on middle frames. Visually unmistakably different from ordinary white truce flag. Do NOT bake the word Really into sprite; text will be live UI.
Row 3 LEAVE: medieval wooden exit door and small ivory cloaked figure (game-icons:exit-door). Six frames: door closed figure left, door opens slightly, opens fully, figure crosses threshold, disappears into dark interior, door settles ajar. Dark door has readable gold edge highlights and teal interior. Keep all motion inside frame.
Row 4 MUSIC ON: pair of antique ivory/gold musical notes (game-icons:musical-notes) with a small teal accent. Six frames notes drift upward by 1,2,3 logical pixels then return, tiny square trailing sparkles, retain exact stable scale.
Row 5 MUSIC MUTED: SAME musical notes now dim slate and ivory, a clearly visible diagonal muted rust slash across them (inspired by game-icons:mute), slash persistent in ALL six frames. Tiny subdued note movement, no sparkles, muted state immediately recognizable.
NO titles, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO decorative button frames. Exact regular 6x5 sprite layout.
packaging: Original transparent sheets preserved in sources/. Equal 229px source cells extracted and normalized to 64px using nearest-neighbor resampling. No generated artwork redrawn.
